Austin Reaves led the Oaks with 32 points in just 22 minutes, 8 of 14 from the field, 6 of 10 from three and 10 of 10 at the line, with 4 rebounds, 3 assists, a steal and no turnov

The last time these teams met it went the other way. In C109 the Warriors came to Oakland for game 2 of the preseason and beat the Oaks, one of the nine straight losses the Oaks took through rookie camp and the preseason. The first meeting that counted went to Oakland, on the Warriors' floor. Oa
